'''Shey Tapani University''', an institute named after [[Emperor (Tapani)|Emperor]] [[Shey Tapani]], was located on [[Estalle Island]] and [[Destato Island]] on [[Procopia/Legends|Procopia]] in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]]. The institution was established the year that the first [[Emperor (Tapani)|Emperor]] brought his [[Tapani Empire|new government]] to Procopia.

The ancient campus on Estalle Island once constituted the entirety of the university, but the school grew too large and the cost of real-estate on Estalle Island meant that the rest of the institution was located on Destato Island, approximately 400 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] away. At the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the original campus only contained the legal graduate school, the university's upper administrative offices, and a museum.
